images.title: A double number line, g above and mg below
images.purpose: Show that a milligram line works like the kg and g line: 1 g is 1,000 mg, 8 g is 8,000 mg, 2 g 40 mg is 2,040 mg and 6,300 mg is 6 g 300 mg.
images.composition: Two long lines with four matching ticks, grams on the top line and milligrams on the bottom line, and two arrows.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LINE: a thin dark #1F2937 horizontal line at y 270 from x 130 to x 1326 with an open circle (14 px) at each end, and exactly 4 vertical tick marks (40 px tall, 4 px thick) at x 210, 557, 903, 1250, equally spaced (the marks are not drawn to scale). The unit word g (40 px, bold, teal #0072B2) is at the left end, x 60, above the line. BOTTOM LINE: the same kind of line at y 500 with the same 4 tick marks at the same x positions, directly under the top ticks. The unit word mg (40 px, bold, amber #E69F00) is at the left end, x 60, below the line. TOP LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 200): 1 g at x 210; 2 g 40 mg at x 557; 6 g 300 mg at x 903; 8 g at x 1250. BOTTOM LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 580): 1,000 mg at x 210; 2,040 mg at x 557; 6,300 mg at x 903; 8,000 mg at x 1250. ARROW: a dashed teal #0072B2 curved arrow from the top tick at x 1250 down to the bottom tick at x 1250, arrowhead at the bottom, with the label × 1,000 (40 px, bold, teal) beside its middle. ARROW: a dashed amber #E69F00 curved arrow from the bottom tick at x 903 up to the top tick at x 903, arrowhead at the top, with the label ÷ 1,000 (40 px, bold, amber) beside its middle. CAPTION at the bottom centre, y 740: the text g to mg: × 1,000; mg to g: ÷ 1,000 (40 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Nothing else in the frame.
labels: g to mg: × 1,000; mg to g: ÷ 1,000
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of tick marks that differs from 4 on each line
a g and mg pair that does not match: 1 g and 1,000 mg, 2 g 40 mg and 2,040 mg, 6 g 300 mg and 6,300 mg, 8 g and 8,000 mg
images.takeaway: g to mg is × 1,000, just like kg to g, and the mg part of a mixed weight takes three places.
images.description: A double number line with grams above and milligrams below showing 1 g, 2 g 40 mg, 6 g 300 mg and 8 g with their milligrams.
images.context: Concept image for Milligram. It follows the idea of the g and mg double number line in your maths book and uses the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Compare it with the kg and g line the student has already seen. The slip to watch: thinking 1 g is 100 mg.

image_decisions.why: The same shape of line for a new unit shows that the rule is the same.
